skill: push_to_goal
dsl_version: 2
subtasks:
- id: pre_contact
  anchor: object
  offset:
  - 0.0
  - 0.0
  - 0.05
  weight: 0.3
- id: goal
  target_entity: object
  metric: goal_progress
  weight: 0.7
phases:
- id: approach
  type: approach
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_object
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.05
    tolerance: 0.01
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.5
      default: 0.2
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: add
  retries:
    max_attempts: 0
    strategy: repeat
  subtask_id: pre_contact
- id: align_to_object
  type: align
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_object
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    tolerance: 0.005
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    lateral_offset_x:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - -0.02
      - 0.02
      default: 0.0
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.x
        mode: add
    lateral_offset_y:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - -0.02
      - 0.02
      default: 0.0
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.y
        mode: add
  retries:
    max_attempts: 0
    strategy: repeat
  subtask_id: pre_contact
- id: push_to_goal
  type: push
  generator: impedance_motion
  control: impedance_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_object
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    offset_along_axis:
      distance: 0.15
      axis: task_goal_direction
      mode: add_to_offset
      sign: positive
    tolerance: 0.02
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    push_distance:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.25
      default: 0.15
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset_along_axis.distance
        mode: replace
  guards:
  - id: force_check
    when: during_phase
    predicate: force_below
    threshold: 25.0
    on_failure: continue
  retries:
    max_attempts: 0
    strategy: repeat
  subtask_id: goal
